name: mermaidman

scripts.wasm:build: cd apps/web/src/rust-engine && wasm-pack build --target web && cp pkg/mermaidman_engine.js pkg/mermaidman_engine_bg.wasm pkg/mermaidman_engine.d.ts ../../public/wasm/
